integrity: The Lie-endomorphism variety and the Nijenhuis torsion are reconstructed directly. The proof reduces every Nijenhuis fiber to a matrix centralizer and uses the exact centralizer dimension for nonscalar 2-by-2 matrices. A standalone verifier exhaustively checks the equations and pair counts over four prime fields.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers all Yau twists of the two-dimensional affine Lie algebra, not arbitrary two-dimensional Hom-Lie algebras.

The primary Das-Sen publisher full text was not accessible through the available public route; its metadata and abstract were checked, and the exact definition was independently checked in a full public preprint that cites it.
A specialized or differently indexed finite-field computation may contain an equivalent census.
title: Nijenhuis census for all Yau twists of the two-dimensional affine Lie algebra
